summary: WebRTC fallback path causes SSE "trickle" connection to miss final epilogue after reconnect
description:
Issue summary:
Customers using the browser SDK report that when the client falls back from SSE to a WebRTC datachannel (fast reconnect after a flaky mobile network), the server-side SSE stream appears to deliver all prefix tokens but the final epilogue (closing sentence/metadata block) never arrives. The client sees a successful reconnect and partial completion, but the last paragraph and the "choice: done" metadata are missing.

Impact:
- Affects BrightNote Labs (enterprise) production traffic in eu-west; intermittent (~2-3% of streaming sessions during mobile network handoffs)
- User-visible: trailing sentence or final JSON metadata block omitted, causing client to wait indefinitely for end marker or to treat the response as truncated

Environment:
- Browser SDK v1.12.2 (Chrome & Safari mobile)
- Server side: Hosted API behind streaming-proxy (edge-router -> api-gateway -> serving-runtime)
- Model: redwood-v2-large, long-form summarization workloads (avg 1.2k tokens)
- Observed primarily during WebRTC fallback path (client chooses WebRTC datachannel when long polling/SSE flake)

Steps to reproduce (observed):
1. On mobile (cellular) with intermittent connectivity, start a streaming SSE generation request via SDK with streaming:true.
2. Induce a short disconnect (toggle airplane mode or force network path migration).
3. Client falls back to creating a WebRTC datachannel and attempts to resume the session using our resume token protocol.
4. Server accepts resume and replays buffered prefix tokens. Client receives content up to the last few tokens, but never receives the final epilogue JSON (closing choice/metadata).

Observed logs / snippets (redacted):
- edge-router: INFO 2026-03-09T14:21:12Z session=bn-89ac resume accepted path=webrtc-fallback
- api-gateway: DEBUG 2026-03-09T14:21:12Z req=0x7f2ff reattach-session token=*** resume_offset=129876
- serving-runtime: WARN 2026-03-09T14:21:12Z session bn-89ac partial_flush final_chunk_written=true kv_flush_deferred=true
- serving-runtime: INFO 2026-03-09T14:21:12Z choice_stream_end_emitted=false
- client SDK console: warn: "stream resumed but no terminating metadata after 12s"

Notes:
- This appears different from simple chunk duplication or splitting. The prefix is reassembled correctly and tokens look consistent; only the terminal metadata and final punctuation are missing.
- Customers sometimes report the client eventually drops the session after a user-visible spinner timeout (5-15s).

Desired outcome:
- Ensure that when a resume occurs over WebRTC fallback, the server emits the terminal epilogue (final JSON event or end marker) reliably, or the SDK should surface a deterministic end-of-stream event after a bounded wait to avoid UX hang.

investigation_notes: Initial reproduce using Chrome mobile emulation with network toggles showed consistent loss of terminal metadata when client switches to WebRTC datachannel mid-stream.
Edge-router logs indicate normal resume handshake; api-gateway accepts session reattach; serving-runtime shows final_chunk_written=true but choice_stream_end_emitted=false in some runs.

Hypothesis: final epilogue emission races with a cleanup path that can be triggered by transport change. If flush-to-transport fails mid-commit, cleanup may mark stream completed without sending metadata.
Secondary hypothesis: datachannel MTU/fragmentation combined with proxy reassembly under HTTP/2 priority changes can drop the control frame containing end-marker when switching transport layers.

Staging mitigation: emit synthetic terminal metadata on cleanup when transport swap is detected; reduces occurrences in canary tests. Longer-term fix requires persisting final epilogue into session ledger before resume ack.
Related: see linked PRs for instrumentation added to serving-runtime (logs for choice_stream_end_emitted) and proxy handshake traceability.
resolution:
Workaround deployed to staging (2026-03-12): server cleanup path emits a synthetic terminal metadata event when it detects a transport switch during finalization. Canary with BrightNote shows >90% reduction in missing epilogues.

Planned permanent fix: ensure final epilogue is durably persisted to session ledger and only ACK resume after ledger write (server-side), plus SDK change to include deterministic end-of-stream timer (client-side). Target for full rollout: 2026-03-19 after code review and QA.

Follow-ups:
- ENG-TO-DO: Implement ledger persist-and-ack (PR opened: github.com/redwood/serve/pull/4123).
- SDK-TO-DO: Add end-of-stream fallback timer and expose explicit "resumed_but_no_end" event to app developers (PR planned).
- OPS-TO-DO: Monitor eu-west streaming error rate post-rollout and update runbook with WebRTC-fallback checks.

Ticket will be updated when permanent fix is scheduled and after full rollout verification.
